purpose: Teach: 変貌/賛美/洞察/バリュー/感度/時速/不必要/インタフェース

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の変貌に対応しろ
lines.en: Ren, adapt to the changes in the lab.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Clear expectation delivered with quiet confidence. Measured pace, steady eye contact. The tone of someone who knows Ren can do this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教員を賛美する気持ちで取り組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll approach it with appreciation for your guidance.
lines.style: Sincere and slightly formal. Careful enunciation on the commitment. A beat of earnestness — not performative, but genuinely respectful. Quiet determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データへの洞察を深めろ
lines.en: Ren, deepen your insights into the data.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly in the voice. Firmer than the first instruction — this matters. Not impatient, but precise. The weight of 'deeper' lands clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究のバリューを社会に示します
lines.en: Yes. I'll demonstrate the research's value to society.
lines.style: Urgent undercurrent but controlled. He's absorbing the challenge, not panicking. Breath steadier this time — focus sharpening. Slight nod in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験装置の感度を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, verify the sensitivity of the experimental equipment.
lines.style: Practical, grounded tone. This is concrete work. Not softer, but less abstract than the previous direction. Expectant but not doubting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表ペースは時速感覚で進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll progress through the presentation at a measured pace.
lines.style: Slight breathlessness as he's mentally organizing. Quick, then catching himself to sound measured. Resolute on the final phrase. He's building momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、不必要なデータは捨てろ
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. The most direct instruction yet. No preamble — this is clarity. Brief and final-sounding, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置のインタフェースを整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the experimental interface clearly.
lines.style: Quiet close to the exchange. Soft finality on 'clearly'. Ren's voice settles — commitment confirmed, understood. Trailing off gently, like a door closing quietly.
